title: Bind length-22 census receipts to the derived split domain
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Add `research/f7-l22-receipt-domain/`, answering #4221 Open next question 2 without editing frozen packages. The successor checker independently reimplements #3708's necessary-condition arithmetic instead of trusting a copied eleven-split table, then binds the derived domain to four completed prior receipts plus seven deep receipts.

It checks unique split identity, completion/hits, 251-prefix coverage, recorded totals and exact source identity, with adversarial acceptance controls. No giant census, engine-soundness proof, newly established f(7)=24, new κ or selected-frontier change.

## Task and overlap

Card `census-pruning-audit`, refined to acceptance-domain binding. Scientific base `b58ad9ef4d4e861b0eaa5dba41742bdc072dca51`, revision 7. Exact source pins in SOURCES.json. Nick Petalas's #4221 head `9d21222c67ecd40f49935a1e56b11f2b50d54613` and #3708 head `ba1aff20ee3ce3dce35e4978feab0b6be08c7168` are credited predecessors.

Canonical main remains `624de9dc66858af0945e5f8a0942488d62280d43`; guidance, selected record and scientific inputs are unchanged. Publication-time overlap refresh at 2026-10-22 22:27 UTC covered 392 open PRs, 3,875 Discussion records and all 5,862 tracked notes in the searched worktree. Exact-term matches were predecessor/own notes; neither publication branch had an existing PR in an all-state head lookup. Separate all-state title/body searches checked differently named contributions. This is not proof of novelty. Discussion post failed; no public reservation is claimed.

## Validation

CPython 3.12.13, standard library:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/f7-l22-receipt-domain --check-only
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/f7-l22-receipt-domain
```

Metadata and registered normal/-O runs pass: `domain=11 prior=4 deep=7 controls=30 no_census_replay`. The historical node sum 173,808,188,827 is authenticated recorded evidence, not freshly executed work. No C compilation, giant census, Lean build or selected construction replay. Separate read-only AI review found no blocking mathematical or acceptance defect; no independent human/formal endorsement.

Committed-byte/source-history preflight, deterministic package export integrity, and a Git-free cold export replay in normal and optimized modes also pass. The refreshed canonical launcher reproduces the same acceptance result.

## Limitations

The explicit engine hash binds the seven deep rows. Prior receipt engine provenance is retained history, and three prior-complete rows are unsharded control runs rather than per-shard logs. Necessity proofs and engine soundness remain inherited.

## Credit

Retains Nick Petalas, Ross Richardson, Aaron Wang, Nicholas Stone, navinor and the predecessor lineage named in README. Prepared for codyw912 with substantial OpenAI Astra assistance and separate AI review; Apache-2.0.

## Open next questions

Open next questions are independently replaying the deep exclusions and formalizing the pair-identity/rotation implication, each separately scoped and budgeted. No devenv or agent configuration is included.
